papers.title: DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators
papers.abstract: First unified benchmark evaluating LLM-driven data preparation across data construction and quality evaluation capabilities. Releases Data-Construction-Skill agent and Distributional Alignment Score (DAS) metric for downstream-grounded assessment.

papers.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
papers.abstract: LLM training shifts toward interaction-driven self-evolution. This work reconciles task diversity with verification reliability through agent skills, introducing a co-evolutionary framework where proposer, solver, and skill controller interact in reinforcement learning loops.

papers.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: A PyTorch-native training framework designed for agentic RL research, enabling researchers to modify algorithms end-to-end without threading changes through multiple layers. Offers performance comparable to state-of-the-art Megatron-based systems.

papers.title: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
papers.abstract: Addresses production agent failures stemming from context management challenges. Introduces five primitives for agentic lifecycle management and demonstrates validated compaction achieving linear token cost while preserving fidelity in reasoning contexts.

papers.title: Interactive Training 2: Auditable Control Plane for Live Model Training
papers.abstract: Open-source control plane enabling training applications to declare exposed settings and actions. Humans and automated controllers submit requests through unified interface, with training loop validating and applying changes at safe control points.

papers.title: Scaling Native Multimodal Pre-Training From Scratch
papers.abstract: Investigates optimal model size and token count for vision-language model training under fixed computational budget. Demonstrates language and multimodal objectives exhibit distinct scaling behaviors, with data composition significantly affecting efficiency.

papers.title: Three-Body Scattering for Generative Modeling
papers.abstract: Proposes energy-based generation method enabling one-step generators through sample-level projectile interactions. Achieves strong FID scores on ImageNet-256 with minimal computational overhead over diffusion-based approaches.

papers.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
papers.abstract: Studies on-policy distillation for multi-turn agentic tasks. ReOPD reuses pre-collected trajectories as prefixes, addressing distribution shifts while reducing tool calls during training and improving efficiency over online approaches.

papers.title: LAMAR: An Open Language-Aware Multilingual Alignment Reranker
papers.abstract: Addresses multilingual retrieval by accounting for both semantic relevance and language coherence. Cross-encoder trained with English-anchored distillation and preference alignment achieves strongest performance across languages.

papers.title: O-VAD: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection through Object-Centric Tracking and Reasoning
papers.abstract: Training-free agentic framework for industrial anomaly detection emphasizing object state evolution. Tracks spatial-temporal dynamics and reasons over object trajectories, outperforming frontier VLMs and fine-tuned methods across datasets.

cc_updates.body: Added Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok. Added sandbox.network.strictAllowlist setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting. Added DirectoryAdded hook that fires after /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root control request registers a new working directory mid-session. Added mcp_server_errors to the headless stream-json init event, listing --mcp-config entries skipped by config validation; terminal runs print a startup warning. Added the workflowSizeGuideline settings key so the advisory Dynamic workflow size guideline can be set from any settings file. Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json: subagents spawned at depth-2+ now appear when --forward-subagent-text is set. Fixed claude -p text output dropping the answer already produced when a turn dies on a mid-stream API error. Fixed /model picker showing the merged Opus row as plain 'Opus' instead of 'Opus (1M context)'. Removed Opus 4.7 from fast mode; /fast now applies to Opus 5 and Opus 4.8. Subagents can now spawn nested subagents up to depth 3 by default (was 1).

Changed /code-review to run as a background subagent, so review work no longer fills your conversation and keeps stacked slash commands as its review target. Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text for word and line deletions in --ax-screen-reader mode. Fixed Windows paths with \u-prefixed segments being corrupted into CJK characters in tool inputs. Fixed the left arrow key discarding the conversation with no undo. Fixed multi-line paste collapsing into one line in terminals that encode pasted newlines as Ctrl+J. Fixed /context reporting stale pre-compact token usage after compacting from the message picker. Fixed /ultrareview failing on descriptive arguments. Fixed spurious '[Request interrupted by user]' messages after interrupted tool calls.
